reference_images.description: Up to 10 reference images for subject, object, or scene consistency. At least one reference (image, video, or audio) is required.

reference_videos.description: Up to 5 reference videos (MP4 or MOV, 1-15s each, total no more than 15s) for motion or scene guidance.

resolution.description: Output resolution tier. Use 480p for quick drafts and 1080p for higher-quality output.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible results. Range is 0 to 2147483647.
